# `std::scope` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/std/scope.lani#L14)

Layer: `std`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Scoped stacks, phase S0: one reservation with two bump ends (packed u8/i32 views low, other views high), marks with two-store release, in-place growth of the newest growable on each end, Scratch frames and Soa2/Soa3 column groups. Executable on x86_64 Linux through the GPU compiler; beat Vec by 8.8-37.6x and alloc::arena by 1.35-1.72x on the S0 benchmarks.
